newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Jan-April C/A deficit rises to $791.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Jan-April C/A deficit rises to $791.4 mln.

text.p: Slovakia's current account deficit rose to $791.4 million in January-April from a $603.9 million deficit in the same period in 1996, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said in its May monetary survey, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters on Tuesday
The NBS has yet to release capital account data. The latest capital account figures showed a $287.7 million surplus for the January-February period of 1997.
SLOVAK CURRENT ACCOUNT JAN-APRIL 97 Q1 1997 JAN-APRIL 96
Note: The NBS used the following exchange rate: $=32.870 Slovak crowns
